definitions.explanation: A marine cephalopod with ten arms, two of which are longer tentacles. Squid is a popular food in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{烏賊|いか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ordered squid sashimi at the izakaya.

examples.japanese: {烏賊|いか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スミ→墨：02155_sumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}いて→吐く：04397_haku⟧⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: Squid squirt ink to escape from enemies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{烏賊焼|いかや}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate grilled squid at the summer festival.

notes:
{烏賊|いか} refers to squid. The kanji literally means "crow thief" (from an old legend). Also commonly written イカ in katakana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {烏賊|いか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (squid sashimi)
- ⟦{烏賊焼|いかや}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (grilled squid)
- {烏賊|いか}⟦そうめん→そうめん：noentry⟧ (squid cut into thin noodle-like strips)
- {烏賊|いか}⟦フライ→フライ：11124_furai⟧ (fried squid)
- {烏賊|いか}⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧ (squid ink pasta)

COUNTING PATTERNS:
⟦{杯|はい}→杯：00933_hai⟧ (whole squid) or ⟦{匹|ひき}→匹：00939_hiki⟧

WATCH OUT:
{烏賊|いか} is distinct from ⟦{蛸|たこ}→蛸：04323_tako⟧ (octopus): squid have 10 arms while octopuses have 8.
